title: Capture of a live body run
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Boolean Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, and choose find and startup modes. For an input word $x$, configuration $c$ of the padded body machine on $x$, and time $t$, suppose the body-source run from $c$ is not halted at every time $u<t$. Then the host machine, started with the capture of $c$ using the corresponding body-call state, reaches after $t$ steps exactly the capture of the body-source configuration reached from $c$ after $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration $c$ of the padded body machine on $x$
For every $u<t$, the body-source run from $c$ is not halted
